::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `SetBoxPlotEffect`

Sets box appearance\index{graphs!box plots} (in box plots) for new projects.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
SetBoxPlotEffect(BoxEffect effect)
```

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| [`BoxEffect`](#boxeffect) effect | The effect to apply to the boxes. |
:::
